# Run The House

The house on Linden Lane, the two cars and everything with a plug or a warranty. It never ends: something is always due for a filter, an inspection or a quote. I keep the records; Renata decides with me on anything over $1,000.

## Scope

- The 1998 two-story house with a basement: structure, roof, mechanicals, the yard and the neighbors we deal with about it.
- The [[kitchen-and-bath-renovation]] and any later project on the house.
- Both cars: the 2014 Vantrel Tessera minivan and the 2021 Vantrel Arden hybrid sedan. Service, repairs, replacement.
- Appliances: purchase dates, warranties, service intervals and manuals, all in the [[home-and-vehicle-register]].
- Not here: the home, auto and umbrella policies themselves ([[manage-family-finances]], see [[auto-insurance-policy]]), Mom's house ([[support-moms-care]]), Maya's driving lessons ([[support-the-kids]]).

## Current State

- Kitchen weeks from done: countertops installed 2026-10-14, punch list open, final inspection booked for 2026-11-05 ([[kitchen-remodel]]). Total is $86,240 against an $80,000 plan ([[renovation-budget-tracker]]).
- The minivan needs a $3,400 transmission repair or a replacement; decision due 2026-12-15 ([[replace-the-minivan]], [[should-maya-drive-the-old-minivan]]).
- Roof is 28 years old. Nothing leaking; quotes planned for spring 2027 ([[roof-replacement]]).
- Heat pump water heater running since 2025-05-21; furnace replacement is reading only ([[home-energy-retrofits]]).

## Active Projects and Workflows

- [[kitchen-and-bath-renovation]] with [[kitchen-remodel]] still active.
- [[replace-the-minivan]].
- [[roof-replacement]] (Idea).
- [[seasonal-house-maintenance-checklist]], run in April and October.
- [[log-a-new-appliance-or-warranty]] whenever something new arrives.

- [ ] Decide on the minivan by 2026-12-15.
- [ ] Register the Kestova appliance warranties and add them to the register.
